# CA Plastics Research Atlas

> A static, independent atlas of plastic-related research connected to California. It lists the researchers, institutions and works behind that research, built from public bibliographic data (OpenAlex) and public funding and monitoring sources.

Independent research atlas; profiles are generated from public bibliographic data.

## Main pages

- [Atlas home](https://plastiverse.live/): overview and entry points to every view
- [Experts](https://plastiverse.live/experts): California-connected plastics researchers
- [Collaboration network](https://plastiverse.live/network): who co-authors with whom
- [Institutions](https://plastiverse.live/institutions): institutions with California-connected plastics research; one page per institution at https://plastiverse.live/institution#inst=<institution ID>
- [Monitoring](https://plastiverse.live/monitoring): monitoring sources and samples
- [Funding](https://plastiverse.live/funding): grants and awards
- [Evidence map](https://plastiverse.live/evidence): publication and evidence views
- [Policy](https://plastiverse.live/policy): policy context
- [Related resources](https://plastiverse.live/resources): other data and tools
- [Glossary](https://plastiverse.live/glossary): terms used in the Atlas
- [About](https://plastiverse.live/about): method, scope and limitations
- [Sitemap](https://plastiverse.live/sitemap.xml): index of all static pages

## Entity pages (static, one per expert or institution)

- Expert profiles: https://plastiverse.live/experts/<OpenAlex author ID>/
- Institution profiles: https://plastiverse.live/institutions/<institution ID>/

## Data and licence

- Data: CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
- Code: MIT
- Archived release and citable DOI (concept, always resolves to the latest release): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24124016
